task_name: Zustand dummy store (isDummy, entities, role, toggle, localStorage persist)

concerns_addressed: TDD ordering (QUALITY BAR 'tests written BEFORE implementation') is not verifiable from git: this SHA range contains a single commit holding both store.ts and store.test.ts. The test file documents explicit RED cycles 1-3 and their expected failure modes; no contradicting evidence found, so recorded as unverifiable observation rather than a defect.

Determinism seam verify: toggle() is arity-0 and calls the generator with zero arguments (store.ts:75-83); the cycle-1b test asserts generateMock.mock.calls[0] has length 0 and that a passed Date is ignored (store.test.ts:66-72). No toggle(date) path exists anywhere.

Init/refresh path verify (Story 1 B): isDummy initializes from localStorage at module creation (store.ts:69) and setDummyGenerator repopulates entities when isDummy is true and entities are still null (store.ts:58-63); cycle-2 test isolates modules, pre-seeds the flag, and asserts non-null + deep-equal entities (store.test.ts:86-116).

Ephemeral-entity rule verify (Story 3 R4): entities are only ever held in Zustand state; persistFlag writes/removes only DUMMY_FLAG_KEY, and toggle OFF sets dummyEntities to null (store.ts:41-46, 76-79). Test asserts absence of three plausible entities keys (store.test.ts:57-59, 73-75).
Generator-injection slot verify: store.ts imports only 'zustand' — no factory, no apiUrl/fetch, no eager generation at import; T5/T6 plug in via setDummyGenerator without touching store internals.

strengths: Both files match the declared scope exactly (apps/web/src/dummy/store.ts, apps/web/src/dummy/store.test.ts); zero out-of-scope files touched (Topbar/Sidebar/LoginForm untouched).

All four DELIVERABLE scenarios are implemented and covered by 4 passing tests: toggle ON generates exactly once + persists flag; OFF clears flag + entities; persisted-flag refresh repopulates; re-toggle ON regenerates a fresh window (2 total generations, T2 data wins).

QUALITY BAR must-haves all satisfied: flag-only persist, refresh repopulation, locked generator contract (today?): DummyEntities with no-arg invocation, injection slot, before/afterEach hygiene (localStorage.clear + reset + re-registration + jest.restoreAllMocks), conventional commit message feat(dummy): add Zustand dummy store with persisted toggle.
QUALITY BAR must-not-haves all absent: no backend calls, no entity/mutation persistence, no Topbar/Sidebar/LoginForm changes.
SSR-safe: readPersistedFlag/persistFlag guard against a missing localStorage (store.ts:35-46), so importing the module in a Node/server context cannot throw.
Cycle-3 test is genuinely discriminating: it asserts the cycle-2 repopulate guard does NOT fire while isDummy is false (store.test.ts:139), which would otherwise mask a cached/stale generation.
No refactor threshold breached: store.ts 94 lines, store.test.ts 145 lines (both <300); every function is well under 50 lines; no identical logic repeated 3+ times.
Test doubles match the packet: stub generator via setDummyGenerator, real Zustand singleton, real jsdom localStorage; the store itself is never mocked.

issues.description: DummyEntities is declared as `Record<string, unknown>` (a maximally loose placeholder). Downstream Phase B/C guards reading dummyEntities.outlets etc. will receive `unknown` and need casts; worth tightening to the real relational shape once T6's factory lands. Not blocking: T2's packet does not fix the graph shape, and the generator contract remains assignable.

localStorage.clear() is invoked twice in beforeEach with reset() in between. reset() already clears the flag and state, so the second clear is redundant; the duplicated call slightly obscures the test setup intent.

The 'entities never persisted' assertion enumerates three hardcoded key guesses (dummy:entities, dummy:dummyEntities, dummy_entities). Asserting the total localStorage key count (or scanning all stored values for the stub payload) would be a stricter, rename-proof check that no entity data ever serializes.

reset() restores isDummy/dummyEntities/role and clears the persisted flag but does not clear the module-level dummyGenerator slot, so a previously registered generator survives a reset. Harmless today because beforeEach always re-registers, but it is a latent cross-test leakage point if a future test omits re-registration.
